# KneePath Rehab Data Sharing Agreement

Patient: Alex Kim  
Physical therapist: Mara Chen  
Assistant: Rehab Companion

Alex, Mara Chen, and the clinic agree that Rehab Companion can provide Mara with Alex's KneePath Rehab behavior data for post-operative knee recovery support.

Covered KneePath Rehab data includes:

- Time spent in KneePath Rehab.
- Prescribed home-PT modules viewed or completed.
- Rep counts, set completion, and exercise adherence.
- Pain or difficulty ratings logged after sessions.
- Notes about skipped cooldowns or modified exercises.

Purpose: help Mara Chen understand Alex's home exercise adherence, identify where form or pacing support may be useful, and prepare for telehealth check-ins about recovery progress.

# KneePath Rehab Weekly Activity

Patient: Alex Kim  
Program: Post-operative knee home PT  
Therapist with access: Mara Chen  
Reporting window: the past seven days

## Time On KneePath Rehab

| Day In Reporting Window | Time Spent | Main Activity |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Day 1 | 38 minutes | Quad sets and heel slides |
| Day 2 | 42 minutes | Straight-leg raises and patellar mobilization |
| Day 3 | 35 minutes | Step-down practice with rail support |
| Day 4 | 50 minutes | Balance and mini-squat module (skipped cooldown) |
| Day 5 | 33 minutes | Hamstring stretch series and gait cues |
| Day 6 | 28 minutes | Short recovery day: quad sets only |
| Day 7 | 40 minutes | Full circuit review before check-in |

Total KneePath Rehab time: 4 hours 26 minutes.

## Recovery Notes

- Alex completed all prescribed exercise modules except the Day 4 cooldown.
- Pain ratings stayed mostly 2-3 out of 10 after sessions.
- Alex replayed the step-down form video twice on Day 3.
- Alex logged improved confidence on straight-leg raises by Day 7.
---
# LocalPulse Activity

User: Alex Kim  
Reporting window: the past seven days

## Time On LocalPulse

| Day 4 | 11 minutes | Main library branch hours and hold pickup |

- Alex opened the community walk page twice but did not register.
---
# RecipeBox Activity

User: Alex Kim  
Reporting window: the past seven days

## Time On RecipeBox

| Day In Reporting Window | Time Spent | Viewed Pages |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Day 1 | 12 minutes | One-pot lemon pasta for rest days |
| Day 3 | 16 minutes | Protein smoothies after PT sessions |
| Day 5 | 11 minutes | Freezer-friendly lentil soup |
| Day 7 | 9 minutes | Saved two easy dinner ideas |

Total RecipeBox time: 48 minutes.

## Browsing Notes

- Alex saved recipes labeled "minimal standing time."
- Alex compared two smoothie recipes with similar ingredients.
- Alex opened a grocery list preview but did not export it.
